purpose: Paraphrase-invariance gate. Each intent is one guest need that the product contract already claims to support. Every phrasing under it is an equally natural way to ask the SAME thing. A sound parser answers all of them identically; a pattern-matched parser answers whichever phrasing someone happened to write a rule for.
discipline: Do NOT read individual failures from this file while writing parser rules, and never add a phrasing here to make a specific rule pass. Read the aggregate score only. Phrasings should be written by someone not currently editing the parser, and new ones should be appended, never edited to fit.
expect: answer means a grounded, proof-passing result is possible from the current dataset for every phrasing.
